instruction: Open Windows Magnifier, set the zoom level to 200%, and leave Magnifier open.
gt_steps: Set the Magnifier zoom level to 200%.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$v=(Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\\Software\\Microsoft\\ScreenMagnifier' -Name Magnification -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Magnification; if ($v -eq 200) { Write-Output 'MAGNIFICATION_200' } else { Write-Output ('MAGNIFICATION_' + $v) }"
